title: Craft Blend 3-Mix Solo #17 (PortugueseAzulejo+EthiopianCrossLattice+EgyptianMamluk)
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph with a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus from head to toe, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Subject: ONE real adult Thai woman in her late 30s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, flawless pale-golden skin, sharply defined dark brows, a precise black winged liner with a strong flick, warm brown-bronze eyeshadow, long dramatic lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, strong contour under the cheekbones, deep red glossy lips with a crisp edge, a poised, dramatic expression, demure and soft, dark roots fading smoothly into sun-kissed lighter ends (balayage) hair styled in a short pixie cut, real living eyes. Long oval nails, glossy finish.

Physique: An extraordinarily tall and enormous woman, far beyond any real person, towering and broad. A commanding, statuesque frame with huge broad shoulders, powerful thick arms with hard defined muscle, a strong deep chest, and a long, dense, muscular torso with only a slight inward taper at the waist. Enormous powerful hips and colossal long thighs with hard muscle visible through a soft layer, thick strong calves. Not slim, not delicate, powerful, statuesque and imposing. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Skin: Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a smooth taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh folds. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Body Art: Her bare skin carries 3 different painted patterns at once, together covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, each pattern claiming roughly an equal irregular share of her body rather than any straight line, zones arranged diagonally and asymmetrically. Portuguese azulejo tile (a brilliant white ground with deep cobalt-blue floral borders, wide cobalt bands, dense repeating panel scrollwork) dominates one zone. Ethiopian cross-and-lattice gold pattern (a deep wine-red ground with fine gold lattice linework, wide gold bands, dense lattice linework) dominates the second zone. Egyptian Mamluk brass-and-enamel inlay (a deep black ground with fine gold and silver geometric star inlay, wide gold-and-silver bands, dense geometric star inlay) dominates the third zone. Wherever any two zones meet, the boundary is soft and diagonal rather than a straight line, motifs blending gradually across an irregular border a few inches wide, pigment on living skin throughout, face unpainted.

Pose: seated across two steps.

Footwear: extreme platform stiletto Mary Janes, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Background & Lighting: the blended painted patterns reading crisp against her skin, the hard raking light carving every fold and curve.

Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide. portrait 2:3 vertical.
